title: Deeper/broader ezdxf SAB authoring scope and cross-peer independence refresh
mode: primary-source web research and read-only plan refinement
scope: Resolve the documented scope of ezdxf SAT/SAB authoring for generated 3D controls
Reconcile the detailed ACIS API with the conflicting FAQ statement
Refresh the open-source DWG/DXF peer independence and semantic-evidence boundary
Make the already-planned optional SAB comparator step implementation-ready without adding mandatory validation

method.kind: Read current primary project docs, source index, package metadata, issue evidence, and local plan
method.limitations: The stable Read the Docs pages and mutable GitHub master are not themselves an executed, release-pinned runtime. PyPI provides an exact 1.4.5 source-artifact hash, but that artifact was not downloaded or run. The Autodesk/BricsCAD acceptance statement is project documentation without a published test artifact, model hash, or audit report. The peer landscape screen is not exhaustive.

sources.revision: PyPI ezdxf 1.4.5 source artifact uploaded 2026-10-16, SHA-256 a6c3bbc1a65ce764d97c5beafe6ae693d8ed14c6cdae366b50e1974a79d4a00a; stable docs and GitHub master reviewed 2026-10-18
observed: The current detailed ACIS API publishes body_from_mesh(), export_sab(), and export_dxf(); its API module imports export_sab into the public API.
The docs state SAB version 21800 is sufficient for DXF R2013 and R2018 and describe exporting mesh-derived polyhedra as SAT/SAB that load in Autodesk products and BricsCAD.

The same guide limits the implementation to simple/known ACIS structures, states that there is no ACIS kernel, and warns that unsupported nodes become NONE_ENTITY and lose data; mesh_from_body() projects only flat polygonal faces.

The stable FAQ contradicts the detailed API by saying ezdxf writes SAT only and provides no ACIS creation/editing. The conflict is retained rather than silently normalized; exact-release runtime execution remains required to qualify actual behavior.
sources.evidenceLimit: This supports only a candidate bounded faceted-polyhedron DXF carrier producer. It does not establish arbitrary ACIS editing, curved B-rep semantics, DWG/AcDs reading, a general kernel, or independently reproduced native acceptance.

sources.revision: Current public project/repository routes reviewed 2026-10-18; mutable heads and project capability claims kept distinct from release and runtime evidence
observed: No newly surfaced independent mature implementation was admitted to the existing comparison set.
The plan continues to distinguish independent DWG codecs, ACadRust-correlated application routes, DXF-only readers/writers, projected geometry consumers, raw-carrier inspection, and ACIS kernels.

No single open-source route in this survey supplies an independently qualified chain from version-correct DWG object graph through complete ACIS/AcDs association to general solid semantics and native cross-platform acceptance.
sources.evidenceLimit: This is a scoped source/provenance survey, not proof that no additional implementation exists, and it creates no local defect finding.

assessment.planImpact: Refines existing PAR-07/S2/S3/S8 comparator evidence only. Treat ezdxf as a candidate exact-pinned producer of faceted SAT/SAB DXF controls; preserve the API/FAQ conflict and require any runtime/native observation to be separately recorded. At the existing optional composed checkpoint, prioritize an AC1027 SAB/ACDSDATA owner-association case; do not add per-slice validation or block implementation if unavailable.

implementationReadyChecks: If the optional composed check is reached and ezdxf 1.4.5 is already locally available, author one source-generated closed polyhedron; prioritize AC1027 SAB and generate under temporary storage.
Pin runtime and package identity; capture independent expected vertices/faces/orientation/closure and analytic measures before conversion.
Compare modeler entity identity, group-70 value, SAB size/hash, ACDSDATA key/owner and output disposition separately; a surviving entity or nonempty carrier is not a pass.
Only an optional native run can qualify application acceptance; capture application/version/platform, audit, and measured geometry, otherwise record NOT_RUN and continue.
Keep generated test drawings out of the repository and do not add ezdxf, Python, a peer executable, or native CAD tooling to mandatory build/test dependencies.
Keep existing fast per-slice tests and implementation order unchanged; do not promote any deferred J item or general 3D support claim.

workingTree.reason: The shared checkout contains extensive pre-existing tracked modifications and untracked artifacts. This pass changed the plan and research receipt only, plus closed the prior FIELD receipt's already-validated diff-check status; no unrelated work was altered.
